question: What claim is made about the effect of poison on the body of one who has been bitten by great serpents under the stated condition?
premises: One may be bitten by great serpents.
Poison is the agent at issue.
Poison does not enter the body in that case.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: The condition that prevents poison from entering is not stated in this verse alone
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
